extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's live game-editor broker: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) that brokers a running Unity Editor to MCP clients. The editor-side package connects to Tackle's local bridge (ws://127.0.0.1:9770/editor); the server exposes the editor's scene, objects, and console through a read core (U1) and an undo-grouped write core (U2), so agents can inspect and edit a live scene with every write undoable. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Tackle does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Tackle

skills.description: Read the connected Unity Editor's state, project info, console entries, and current selection.
skills.name: Editor inspection

skills.description: Read the active scene's GameObject hierarchy and individual GameObject properties by hierarchy path.
skills.name: Scene reading

skills.description: Create, modify, and delete GameObjects, add and remove components, instantiate prefabs, and save the active scene; every write is undo-grouped.
skills.name: Scene editing

skills.description: Create and patch C# scripts under Assets/, apply batched writes as a single undo group, and undo or redo steps.
skills.name: Script authoring and undo
